Resolver contract

DA_AnimationSet_Common maps BodyId + ActionTag + Facing + ActivePage + VisualLayer + ItemAppearanceId to a verified sequence or explicit fallback. Return MissingLayer hides that cosmetic layer without changing stats. Missing required body sequence uses a legal debug pose and a diagnostics warning; no crash or invisible collider-only avatar in a public build.

URPGPaperDollComponent reads FRPGPresentationState and resolves one active body/action clock. ABP_Common consumes it through the installed PaperZD adapter; equipment layers sample the same normalized phase/frame. Network clients receive accepted action identity/time/facing, not one RPC per animation frame.

Eight-direction production workflow

  1. Freeze canvas size, foot pivot, scale, frame IDs and palette for the verified four-facing base.
  2. Author NE/SE/SW/NW for one locomotion action/body first; review silhouette and fixed-camera projection on slopes.
  3. Author matching outfit/hair/cloak/tool frames page by page. Track every missing combination in the matrix; do not advertise all gear supported from one base diagonal.
  4. Update resolver to eight-direction sectors with explicit four-direction fallback for incomplete actions; keep saved AppearanceIds stable.
  5. Test remote interpolation, action-facing locks, weapon overlap, hats/hair and all supported zoom levels before enabling diagonal clips in the released catalog.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
